component.name: Gosh MIDI Player
component.summary: MIDI file player based on dmidiplayer (Drumstick MIDI File Player)

description.p: Gosh MIDI Player is a Qt 6 and Kirigami MIDI file player for the Plasma desktop, based on dmidiplayer (Drumstick MIDI File Player) by Pedro López-Cabanillas. It follows the system colour scheme in both light and dark. The command name remains dmidiplayer. Advanced features:

ul.li: MIDI Output to ALSA ports or FluidSynth
Transpose song tonality between -12 and +12 semitones
Change MIDI volume level (using MIDI CC7)
Scale song speed between half and double tempo
Piano, MIDI Channels, Rhythm, and Lyrics (Karaoke) views
First-class playlists with shuffle, repeat, and auto-advance
Supports .MID (Standard MIDI files), .RMI (RIFF RMID), .KAR (MIDI Karaoke), and .WRK (Cakewalk) file formats
Plays files straight from network shares — Samba, SSH, WebDAV and anything else KIO can reach

screenshot.caption: Playing a MIDI file with Gosh MIDI Player

description.p: The interface has been rewritten in Qt 6 and Kirigami and now looks and behaves like a native Plasma application, following the system colour scheme in light and dark. Files on network shares, which the file dialog listed but could not open, now play in the app: any address KIO can reach is fetched in the background, together with its companion SysEx dump.
